description: Eight sample-and-hold cells sharing one source, with the trigger inputs normalled down the column.

inputs.text: The voltage the cells sample; with nothing patched here each cell takes a fresh noise value of its own instead.
Samples the source on a rising edge here; with nothing patched, this cell fires whenever the nearest patched trigger above it does.

outputs.text: Holds the voltage its row took at its last trigger, clamped to ±10V.

notes: The top trigger input has no row above it to follow, so with nothing patched there its cell never samples and its output stays at 0V.
With nothing patched to NOISE the module makes its own source: each sample is drawn from a normal distribution and multiplied by 2, or by 4 when Range is set to +/- 10V, then clamped to ±10V.
menu: Range: +/- 5V, +/- 10V — sets how far the module's own noise spreads when the NOISE input is empty, and changes nothing when a source is patched there
